rationale: The last candle shows a sharp spike to the session high of $97.00 on elevated volume, but price is already pulling back to $96.63 with no news catalyst to anchor the move — this looks like a momentum exhaustion spike rather than a breakout with follow-through. With 57 minutes to close, the stock is at 83% of its intraday range, spread is wide at 64.7 bps, and the risk/reward for either direction is unclear: chasing long risks buying the top of a spike, while shorting into a stock that gapped up 2.18% on 2.93x relative volume carries its own risk. I already have a correlated long working in LITE, so adding LSCC long would increase concentration in the same sector without sufficient edge.
